from parity_lab import build_fixture
trace, logs = build_fixture()
policy = [trace.policy_at(r.requested_at).value for r in logs]
source = [trace.source.reference(trace.key, r.requested_at).value
          for r in logs]

print("model:", [r.model_input for r in logs])
print("policy:", policy)
print("source:", source)

code:
from dataclasses import replace
from operations_lab import build_change_packet, decide
packet = build_change_packet()
inventory = tuple(
    replace(a, expires_at=625) if a.artifact_id == "recovery_release"
    else a for a in packet.inventory)
report = decide(replace(packet, inventory=inventory))
print("contract:", report["contract"])
print("action:", report["action"])
print("blockers:", report["blockers"])
title: Hold when recovery evidence expires
